name: web
description: Herramientas web: IP publica, DNS, HTTP checks, QR
author: Nexo

ip.exec: echo "🌐 IP Publica:" && curl -s ifconfig.me && echo "" && echo "ISP: $(curl -s ipinfo.io/org 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

warp-status.exec: echo "WARP:" && warp-cli --accept-tos status 2>/dev/null || echo "No instalado" && echo "" && echo "IP real: $(curl -s ifconfig.me 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

dns.exec: [ -z "$1" ] && echo "Uso: nexo-skill run web dns <dominio>" && exit 1 && echo "🔍 Resolviendo $1..." && host "$1" 2>/dev/null || nslookup "$1" 2>/dev/null || dig "$1" +short 2>/dev/null

qr.description: Genera codigo QR (texto o URL). Args: nexo-skill run web qr <texto>
qr.exec: [ -z "$1" ] && echo "Uso: nexo-skill run web qr <texto>" && exit 1 && echo "$1" | qrencode -t ANSIUTF8 2>/dev/null || echo "❌ qrencode no instalado. sudo apt install qrencode"
